title: B-roll wheel launch
summary: A 90 s keynote-style launch: real-world b-roll under kinetic type, a 'Your [ ]' wheel between chapters, the product's real screens floating over footage, a beat montage at 35 %, One More Thing, dot-to-logo end.

craft: frame 0 is the poster (a person already in frame)
every scene starts on a beat (0.06 + 2k s)
burst at 32-35 s, 8 shots, beat then half-beat
chips and captions stay locked while the world cuts
music ducks for One More Thing

style.ground: light paper with a soft radial ground, alternating with graded b-roll
style.type: geometric grotesque headlines (700), humanist sans body, mono labels
style.accent: one light accent: swept behind ink on paper, a block behind ink on footage
style.grade: warm, slightly desaturated; darker under type
style.motion_under_type: footage keeps moving under type; type holds still once landed

tool.footage: Pexels stock, 9 clips, graded and cut in project/tools/cuts.py

reference.name: A consumer AI assistant's 94 s launch film (user-supplied)

result.example_product: Muse, Meta's personal AI agent (unofficial spec film, not affiliated with Meta)

from_product: brand palette (9 roles) and two fonts
one wide illustration or hero image
two crops of real site/app cards with their key rows
generated: one 90 s 120 BPM music track (prompt in project/tools/music.md)
footage: 9 b-roll clips: stock or generated (slots in project/tools/broll-prompts.md)

fits: software with a real UI and a clear before/after
brands with an illustration or mascot
launches that need warmth as well as product
avoid: products with no screens to show
under 30 s (use a cut-down: open, one chapter, montage, end)
conflicts_with: one-shape-never-cut methods across the whole film (this film cuts on purpose)
